name: Bloodmage: Rage turns attack power into spell damage and boosts Reave (#1348)
contract: Rage 504241 (20% / 10%) and 504895 (40% / 20%): "Increases your spell damage by $s1% of your attack power and the damage dealt by Reave by $s2%." Effect 0 is aura 237 SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_DAMAGE_OF_ATTACK_POWER with MiscValue 127 (all seven schools), consumed in Unit::SpellBaseDamageBonusDone at Unit.cpp:9523 as CalculatePct(GetTotalAttackPowerValue(BASE_ATTACK), GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscMask(...)), which is precisely what the spell_power metric reads. Effect 1 is aura 108 with MiscValue 0 = SPELLMOD_DAMAGE and EffectSpellClassMask [4194304, 0, 0], which over SpellFamilyName 26 selects exactly the eight Reave ranks (800490 and 802463-802469) and nothing else. A level 80 character's attack power is far above 50, so 20% of it is comfortably above the 10 point floor asserted here; the attack power is recorded in the result for the exact relation. No source or SQL change is involved.

steps.label: Attack power the 20%/40% is taken from
Reave carries no damage modifier yet
Rank 1 adds 20% of attack power to Shadow spell power
Rank 2 adds 40% of attack power to Shadow spell power
